content: Forex scalping transaction costs: spreads 0.1-3 pips for majors, ECN commissions -7 per round-turn standard lot. Scalping strategies often look highly profitable in backtests but become untradable once real costs applied -- high trade volume means commissions erode large share of profit. Transaction cost models range from flat (simplest, represents fixed commission) to linear to piecewise-linear to quadratic (most accurate for slippage/market impact, since these are non-linear). A backtest without commissions/spread/slippage always looks cleaner than reality.
